methodologicalNovelty: Model each number's historical appearances as a discrete-time self-exciting point process with exponentially decaying excitation plus baseline intensity, distinct from prior renewal/survival-hazard and BOCPD families.

guard.whyDistinct: Those families model waiting-time/renewal structure; v311 adds history-dependent excitation triggered by prior events and cross-number excitation variants without reusing OOS data for tuning.
